english.title: Pilot of public transport aircraft fail to select alternate destination aerodrome when Instrument Flight Rules apply
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of a public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), on a proposed flight from **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) to **(..SPECIFY DESTINATION..), failed to select before take-off a destination alternate aerodrome, when, according to the information available, the aircraft would as regards that flight be required to be flown in accordance with the Instrument Flight Rules at the aerodrome of intended landing.
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 131(13) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
